meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein oily skin ke liye ₹500 ke budget mein kai behtareen face washes available hain, jo excess oil aur acne (pimples) ko control karne mein madad karte hain. Oily skin ke liye hamesha **Salicylic Acid, Glycolic Acid, Niacinamide, ya Green Tea** wale cleansers acche maane jaate hain.

₹500 ke andar kuch sabse acche options ye hain:

| Face Wash Ka Naam | Key Ingredients | Estimated Price (INR) | Fayde |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser** | Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc | ₹299 | Pores ko deep clean karta hai aur sebum (oil) production ko control karta hai. |
| **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** | Green Tea, Glycolic Acid | ₹350 - ₹380 (Offers mein aur sasta) | Oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye best hai; pimples ko rokata hai aur skin ko refresh karta hai. |
| **Saslic DS Foaming Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid (2%) | ₹450 ke kareeb | Yeh ek dermatologically recommended face wash hai jo ziddi pimples aur oiliness ke liye kafi asardar hai. |
| **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide | ₹299 | Oil control karne ke sath-sath skin texture ko behtar banata hai aur acne marks ko halka karta hai. |
| **Pilgrim Tea Tree Purifying Foaming Face Wash** | Tea Tree, Salicylic Acid | ₹200 - ₹300 | Natural ingredients ke sath oil aur breakouts ko control karta hai. |

### Sahi Face Wash Chunne ke Kuch Tips:

* Agar aapki skin par **bohot zyada pimples ya acne** hain, toh **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid** ya **Saslic DS** behtar rahega.
* Agar aapko ek **gentle aur refreshing** herbal option chahiye jo daily use ke liye accha ho, toh **Plum Green Tea Face Wash** chun sakte hain.
